variants.name: Starter
variants.purpose: The Abyss Warlock Starter setup looks to maintain the 75% FCR Breakpoint while stacking as many bonus Skill ranks to scale your damage; it also prioritizes capping your resistances with easily found gear.

Weapon-Swap: Magic Staff of Teleportation (Long Staff, 33 Teleport charges, +30 Cold Resist)
Helmet: Lore Skull Cap
Gloves: Magic Heavy Gloves +30% Fire Resist / 25% MF
Belt: Caster Crafted Sharkskin Belt 5% FCR / 10% FHR / +20 Mana / 10% Mana Regen / 10 Fire+Cold+Light Resist
Boots: Magic Heavy Boots 30% FRW / 40% Cold Resist
Amulet: Magic Amulet +1 to Warlock Skills / +40 Life
Other: Check any Daggers and Books you find for +Skill ranks and All Resistance on a Magic Grimoire (prose)

Helmet: Bulwark Bone Visage (ethereal)

quotes: Before you find the Runes and Base for Spirit and Ancients' Pledge, check any Daggers and Books you find for chances at bonus Skill ranks and good affixes like All Resistance on a Magic Grimoire.

An Act 2 Might Mercenary offers a solid tank that provides tons of utility and added damage, especially against the small handful of Magic Immune monsters. Insight provides easy Mana Regeneration via Meditation Aura. Bulwark is a must have for early game survivability for Life Steal. Treachery provides the Attack Speed necessary to Leech as well as Resistances via Fade.

variants.name: Standard
variants.purpose: The Standard Abyss Warlock setup maximizes damage output, maintains the fastest 125% FCR Breakpoint and shreds as much Magic Resistance as possible.

Weapon: Void Kris (Thul Zod Ist; +3 Abyss / +3 Miasma Chain / +3 Bind Demon staffmods)
Helmet: Rare Diadem +2 Warlock Skills / 20% FCR / 30% FRW / +20 All Resist / 25% MF, socketed Guardian's Light Jewel + Ber Rune
Gloves: Caster Crafted Bramble Mitts +20 Mana / 10% Mana Regen / 30 Fire+Cold+Light Resist / +3 Mana after each Kill / 25% MF
Amulet: Mara's Kaleidoscope
Charms: Renewed Black Cleft (crafted Sunder Charm: 24% FHR / +65 Life / 10 MDR / 25% MF; planner name 'Crafted Black Cleft')
6x Grand Charm +1 to Chaos Skills (Warlock) / +45 Life
Prebuff: Call to Arms Crystal Sword + Spirit Monarch on swap: Battle Command x2, then Battle Orders

Helmet: Andariel's Visage (ethereal, 15% IAS / 40% ED Jewel)

quotes: At high enough Skill Ranks, +xx% Magic Damage actually outperforms both -xx% Enemy Resistance and +x to Skill.

Since there's no option of Mercenary that directly increases Magic Damage, you get to use a massive Act 2 Might Mercenary with Insight Giant Thresher as his weapon to shred Magic Immunes while helping to manage Mana issues.
Start runs by buffing yourself with Battle Command 2 times, then Battle Orders from Call to Arms. Summon your Summon Defiler and rebuff them.
With the addition of Black Cleft, all Immunities are broken and your combined -xx% Enemy Magic Resistance gear brings monster's Resistances low enough to deal damage!

variants.name: Magic Find
variants.purpose: The Magic Find Abyss Warlock Variant stacks as much +x% Better Chance of Getting Magic Items as possible while maintaining the 125% FCR Breakpoint and a competent amount of damage scaling; better for Elite Sniping and bosses up to Players 3.

Helmet: Harlequin Crest (Guardian's Light Jewel)
Amulet: Caster Crafted Amulet +2 Warlock Skills / 15% FCR / +20 Mana / 10% Mana Regen / +20 All Resist / 25% MF
Charms: Renewed Black Cleft (crafted Sunder Charm; planner 'Crafted Black Cleft')
5x Grand Charm +1 to Chaos Skills (Warlock) / +45 Life
Prebuff: Call to Arms Crystal Sword + Spirit Monarch on swap

Helmet: Andariel's Visage (ethereal, 15% IAS / 40% ED Jewel)

quotes: Note on this setup you only Consume a Defiler, and do not spawn additional ones. They die too easily in the early game without investment.
While it can continue to farm density, it clears slower than the standard variant.

Off-Hand: Ars Dul'Mephistos Occult Tome (Eld Rune) — allocate Dexterity for 75% Chance to Block

Charms: Prioritize Life on Charms over Magic Find

quotes: Allocate enough Dexterity to reach 75% Chance to Block with Ars Dul'Mephistos (Eld Rune).
Use Rare Boots with high Resistances to over-cap your Resistances. This allows you to deal with hostile Conviction and / or Lower Resist.
Swap to Crown of Ages. This may require slightly more Attributes in Strength to be able to wear.
Prioritize Life on Charms over Magic Find.
Allocate additional points into Blood Oath to max out the damage transferred to your demons.

The Starter Berserk Barbarian uses an Act 2 Might Mercenary with Insight for Damage and Mana Regeneration. Smoke is a cheap Body Armor option for Resistances, while Bulwark is the cheapest Helmet that provides Life Leech and Damage Reduction.

variants.purpose: This is the Standard Best in Slot (BiS) Berserk Barbarian; the balanced jack-of-all-trades version that prioritizes Magic Find while maintaining solid Damage and Teleport mobility, reaching 105% FCR on Weapon-Swap.

Helmet: Harlequin Crest (Guardian's Light Jewel)
Amulet: Caster Crafted Amulet +2 Barbarian Skills / 10% FCR / +20 Mana / 10% Mana Regen / +20 All Resist / 35% MF

21x Small Charm +3 Max Dmg / +20 AR / 7% MF

Other: Immortal King's Will quick-swap helmet for Pindleskin (prose)
Highlord's Wrath + Fire Resistance/Fire Absorb for Travincal (prose)

Helmet: Guillaume's Face (Ist Rune)

quotes: A quick swap to Immortal King's Will achieves maximum Pindleskin farming efficiency as well. Highlord's Wrath along with additional Fire Resistance/Fire Absorb makes this an excellent build for farming Travincal.

The Standard Berserk Barbarian Mercenary is an Act 2 Might Mercenary with Insight for Damage and Mana Regeneration. Treachery and Guillaume's Face maximize this Mercenary's DPS without having Cold Damage. Andariel's Visage can be used for increased survivability.
Alternatively, equip the Berserk Barbarian Mercenary with Stealskull, Skullder's Ire, and Tomb Reaver for a maximum Magic Find, Mercenary-killing approach.

blessed-hammer-paladin.title: Blessed Hammer Paladin Endgame Build Guide for Diablo II: Resurrected Season 14

variants.name: Starter
variants.purpose: The Starter Variant relies heavily on Skills and Faster Cast Rate to deal damage; Lore, Stealth, Spirit Crystal Sword, and Spirit Targe are easily obtainable sources of these stats.

Helmet: Lore Cap
Gloves: Magic Sharkskin Gloves +30% Fire Resist / 25% MF
Belt: Magic Demonhide Sash 24% FHR / +30% Fire Resist
Boots: Magic Chain Boots 40% FRW / +40% Fire Resist
Amulet: Rare Amulet +1 Paladin Combat Skills / 10% FCR / +15 Mana / +20% Fire Resist / Teleport charges (22)

Helmet: Bulwark Crown (ethereal)

quotes: Lore, Stealth, Spirit Crystal Sword, and Spirit Targe are easily obtainable sources of these stats. Life, Resistances, and Faster Hit Recovery are also great stats to help your starter setup.

To keep your Mercenary alive, equip him with a Body Armor and Helmet that provide Resistances and Life. Insight is a fairly easy Runeword to find that gives a great amount of damage and Quality of Life with Meditation. Hire the Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary to gain extra Crowd Control.

variants.name: Standard
variants.purpose: The Standard Blessed Hammer Paladin is well-rounded in speed, survivability, damage, and Magic Find; Spirit Sacred Targe, Sling and Hellwarden's Will enable the 125% FCR breakpoint.

Weapon: Void Kris (Thul Zod Ist; +3 Abyss staffmod)
Helmet: Hellwarden's Will (Death Mask; Guardian's Light Jewel)
Amulet: Mara's Kaleidoscope
Charms: Renewed Black Cleft (crafted Sunder Charm 24% FHR / +65 Life / 10 MDR / 25% MF; planner 'Crafted Black Cleft')
5x Grand Charm +1 Paladin Combat Skills / +45 Life
Grand Charm +1 Paladin Combat Skills / 12% FHR
Prebuff: Call to Arms Double Axe + Spirit Sacred Targe on swap: Battle Command x2, Battle Orders; cast Holy Shield on the swap with higher Skill Level

Helmet: Andariel's Visage (ethereal, 15% IAS / 30% Fire Resist Jewel)

quotes: This build with the Spirit Sacred Targe, Sling and Hellwarden's Will enables you to reach the 125% FCR breakpoint and travel to your destination as fast as possible, as well as output the most damage per second (dps).

Hire a Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary for Crowd Control. Equip him with Insight Giant Thresher for Meditation to keep your Mana Pool full. Andariel's Visage and Fortitude Sacred Armor fill in everything else you need from damage to survivability.

Renewed Black Cleft Sunders enemy Magic Immunity. With the addition of Hellwarden's Will and Sling there is enough Magic Pierce to utilize this sunder charm. There is also Gheed's Wager for more potential Magic Pierce.

variants.name: Ubers
variants.purpose: Ubers (Smite) hybrid: swap helmet and body armor to Guillaume's Face and Chains of Honor Archon Plate, add Grief Phase Blade, Dracul's Grasp and Raven Frost; Smite bosses, Blessed Hammer trash.

Helmet: Guillaume's Face (15% IAS / +30% Lightning Resist Jewel)
Amulet: Caster Crafted Amulet +2 Paladin Skills / 20% FCR / +20 Mana / 10% Mana Regen / +20 All Resist / Teleport charges (27)
Rings: Rare Ring 10% FCR / +15 Dex / +40 Life / +90 Mana / 41% Lightning Resist / 11 Fire+Cold+Poison Resist
Charms: 6x Grand Charm +1 Paladin Combat Skills / +45 Life
2x Grand Charm +1 Paladin Combat Skills / 12% FHR
Prebuff: Treachery: swap in and proc Fade (15% DR, +60 All Resist for 288 s) on the fire next to the River of Flame Waypoint
Call to Arms Double Axe + Spirit Sacred Targe swap: Battle Command x2, Battle Orders
Other: Enigma kept in the cube or on the Mercenary to Teleport between Uber portals (prose)

Helmet: Andariel's Visage (ethereal, 15% IAS / 30% Fire Resist Jewel)

quotes: Swap your helmet and body armor to Guillaume's Face and Chains of Honor Archon Plate. Other important additions are Grief Phase Blade for damage, Dracul's Grasp for a source of LifeTap and x% Chance of Open Wounds, and Raven Frost for Cannot be Frozen.
Swap in Treachery and activate the Fade buff for 15% Damage Reduction and +60 All Resistances for 288 seconds. You can proc this buff on the fire next to the River of Flame Waypoint.
Use Smite for Physical Damage to kill bosses and monsters. Use Blessed Hammer for Magic Damage to kill trash mobs.
Use Enigma to Teleport from place to place (you can store it inside your cube or on your Mercenary).
Alternative Option: Invest only 1 Skill Point into Fanaticism and move the rest into Resist Lightning for the passive Maximum Lightning Resist. This helps against Uber Mephisto's Conviction.

Weapon: Rose Branded War Scepter of the Apprentice (2x Rainbow Facet Jewel / istrune )

variants.name: FoH Starter
variants.purpose: The Starter Variant of the FoHdin relies heavily on Skills and Faster Cast Rate to deal damage; Lore, Stealth, Spirit Crystal Sword, and Spirit Targe are easily obtainable sources of these stats.

Weapon-Swap: Battle Staff of Teleportation (planner: magic Long Staff with Teleport charges)
Helmet: Lore Mask
Gloves: Magic Heavy Gloves 30 Fire Res / 25% MF (prose: shop Charsi/Gheed in Nightmare for Life / Resist / FHR gloves, belts, boots)
Boots: Magic Heavy Boots 40% FRW / 40 Fire Res
Amulet: Magic Amulet +1 Paladin Combat Skills / 10% FCR
Rings: Rare Ring 'Havoc Touch' 10% FCR / 16 Fire Res / 11 Cold-Light-Poison Res (x2)

merc.type: Act 2 Holy Freeze per prose ('Hire the Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary'); planner sets 1-2 use mercType 11 = Might
Helmet: Bulwark Mask

quotes: Lore, Stealth, Spirit Crystal Sword, and Spirit Targe are easily obtainable sources of these stats. Life, Resistances, and Faster Hit Recovery are also great stats to help your starter setup. Check Charsi and Gheed in Nightmare for Gloves, Belts and Boots with these Stats.

Equip your Mercenary with a Body Armor and Helmet that provides Resistances, Life Stolen per hit, and Life. Insight is an easy Runeword to create that gives a great amount of damage and Quality of Life with Meditation. Hire the Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary to gain extra Crowd Control. Use fanaticism to increase his DPS against Immunes.

variants.name: Holy Bolt Starter
variants.purpose: This Holy Bolt Starter Variant is specifically built to farm Areas with Undead/Demon monster types only, empowering your Mercenary with a high level Fanaticism Aura.

Weapon-Swap: Battle Staff of Teleportation (planner: magic Long Staff with Teleport charges)
Helmet: Lore Mask
Gloves: Magic Heavy Gloves 30 Fire Res / 25% MF (prose: shop Charsi/Gheed in Nightmare for Life / Resist / FHR gloves, belts, boots)
Boots: Magic Heavy Boots 40% FRW / 40 Fire Res
Amulet: Magic Amulet +1 Paladin Combat Skills / 10% FCR
Rings: Rare Ring 'Havoc Touch' 10% FCR / 16 Fire Res / 11 Cold-Light-Poison Res (x2)

merc.type: Act 2 Holy Freeze per prose ('Hire the Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary'); planner sets 1-2 use mercType 11 = Might
Helmet: Bulwark Mask

quotes: This holybolt Starter Variant of the FoHdin is specifically built to farm Areas with Undead/Demon monster types only. This allows you to also empower your Mercenary with a high level fanaticism Aura. You still have access to conviction to empower fistoftheheavens if other mob types spawn. Faster Cast Rate and +x to Skills are obtained from Lore, Stealth, Spirit Crystal Sword, and Spirit Targe.

Equip your Mercenary with a Body Armor and Helmet that provides Resistances, Life Stolen per hit, and Life. Insight is an easy Runeword to create that gives a great amount of damage and Quality of Life with Meditation. Hire the Holy Freeze Aura Mercenary to gain extra Crowd Control. Use fanaticism to increase his DPS against Immunes.
Planner set 2 carries the identical item loadout to FoH Starter; only the skill allocation differs.

variants.name: Standard
variants.purpose: This setup allows you to Elite Snipe anywhere and also clear all high value Undead/Demon heavy Areas with ease, prioritizing + Skills, Lightning Skill Damage and -Enemy Lightning Resistance after the 125% FCR breakpoint.

Weapon-Swap: Call to Arms War Scepter (ethereal; +3 Fanaticism / +3 Sanctuary / +3 Vigor base staffmods)
Helmet: Griffon's Eye Diadem (planner socket: Guardian's Thunder Colossal Jewel; table: 1x Rainbow Facet Jewel)

Prebuff: Call to Arms (battlecommand and battleorders before holyshield at the start of a session)

quotes: Prioritize +x to Skills, +xx to Lightning Skill Damage, and -xx to Enemy Lightning Resistance after reaching the 125% Faster Cast Rate Breakpoint. You can also swap out some +x to Skills and add high amounts of Magic Find onto your kit.
Equip your Mercenary with Insight Giant Thresher for Meditation to help manage your Mana. Andariel's Visage and Fortitude Sacred Armor increases his DPS and survivability.
Cast battlecommand and battleorders before you cast holyshield at the beginning of your farming session.

Raven Frost (table footnote 2: Tri-Brid only; prose: 'You need a source of Cannot Be Frozen when fighting Baal and Diablo')

This Variant farms high value Players 8 Areas like Baal, Chaos Sanctuary, and other Undead/Demon only spots. All while maintaining the 75% Faster Cast Rate Breakpoint (125% on Weapon Swap), 48% Faster Hit Recovery, and ~200% Magic Find. You need a source of Cannot Be Frozen when fighting Baal and Diablo. Your Mercenary's decrepify increases your Crushing Blow damage, and their sanctuary Aura will keep targets clumped together for fistoftheheavens.

variants.purpose: The Gold Find Barbarian requires a decent amount of gear prior to being able to effectively farm; use Warcry's Stun with Leap, enabling your Mercenary to kill stuff for maximum gold.

Weapon: Blade of Ali Baba Tulwar (2x magic Jewel 30% Extra Gold)
Off-Hand: Blade of Ali Baba Tulwar (2x magic Jewel 30% Extra Gold)
Weapon-Swap: Echoing Balanced Knife (magic Throwing Knife +3 Warcries)

Amulet: Magic Amulet +1 Warcries / 70% Extra Gold
Rings: Magic Ring 28 Fire Res / 30% Extra Gold

merc.type: Act 2 Might (prose: 'Hire the Might Aura Mercenary')

quotes: Getting things like Resistances, Life, Skills, Damage, overall survivability, and a good Mercenary setup are all pivotal to the build's ability to farm. Use Warcry's Stun with Leap, enabling your Mercenary to kill stuff for maximum gold.

To keep your Mercenary alive, equip him with Treachery and Tal Rasha's Horadric Crest for Life and Resistances. Insight is a pretty easy Runeword to find and farm that gives a great amount of damage and Quality of Life with Meditation. Hire the Might Aura Mercenary, to gain extra Physical Damage.

variants.purpose: The Gold Find Barbarian's main focus is to stack x% Extra Gold From Monsters while maintaining some sort of survivability and damage; main damage from Grief Phase Blade or Oath.

Weapon: Oath (prose alternative; table: Oath Balrog Blade)
Off-Hand: Gemmed Phase Blade (6x Lem Rune) - table lists 'Gemmed Crystal Sword'
Helmet: Immortal King's Will Avenger Guard (sd1d70lu: Cham Rune + Protector's Stone Colossal Jewel; 848y90l7: Cham Rune + Lem Rune)

quotes: Survivability comes from Resistances, Life, Damage Reduction. Your main Damage comes from Grief Phase Blade or Oath. Note: If you need to get back to town, we use the Scroll of Town Portal on the Belt.

Min-Max: Lay your Wake of Fire traps with your main Weapon Swap and switch to your Secondary with Gemmed Crystal Sword, and Phoenix Monarch to maximize your damage output.
